title: Open Mic and Jam @ Boston Johnny's
event_description: Monday night open mic and high-level jam session at Boston Johnny's. All musicians welcome to perform. Sports bar atmosphere with tiki bar and full kitchen serving burgers wings and more.
event_venue_information:
Boston Johnny's - Hollywood's Local Dive Bar and Music Venue

Boston Johnny's is a beloved dive bar and sports bar located on North Dixie Highway in Hollywood Florida. Since its revitalization under current ownership the venue has become a staple for locals seeking great food cold drinks and live entertainment seven nights a week. The bar features an indoor venue and an outdoor tiki bar creating multiple spaces for music and socializing.

Live Music Every Day

Boston Johnny's features live music and entertainment every single day of the week. Mondays host the acoustic jam with Chip Green followed by open mic night with Todd from 9pm to midnight. Wednesdays feature the LightemUp Band for open jam sessions where musicians can play or sing with the house band. The venue also hosts karaoke Thursday through Saturday at various times creating a full week of musical entertainment.

Sports Bar Atmosphere

The venue functions as a full-service sports bar with massive screens including a video wall and two jumbo screens for watching games. NFL Sunday Ticket ensures all football games are available. The bar combines sports viewing with live music creating a unique atmosphere where patrons can catch the game and enjoy live performances simultaneously.

Food and Drink

Boston Johnny's operates a full kitchen serving burgers wings steak bombs and homemade specials. The venue is particularly known for its wings and fish and chips. Dollar wing specials run on Mondays. The full liquor bar serves beer wine and cocktails at reasonable prices. Daily specials include trivia poker and ladies night promotions throughout the week.

Outdoor Tiki Bar

The outdoor tiki bar provides a second entertainment space with its own stage and karaoke setup. The tiki bar hosts karaoke Friday and Saturday nights while live music performs inside. This dual-venue setup allows the bar to offer multiple entertainment options simultaneously. The tiki bar creates a casual beach-like atmosphere despite being inland.

Community Atmosphere

Regular patrons describe Boston Johnny's as a place where everyone knows your name. The staff and owners have built strong connections with the local community. The venue welcomes bikers with ample motorcycle parking. The casual dive bar atmosphere emphasizes friendly service and good times over pretension. Great local crowd and nice people create a welcoming environment for both regulars and first-time visitors.
